newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GUD Holdings shares see active trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GUD Holdings shares see active trade.

text.p: Shares in diversified manufacturer GUD Holdings Ltd saw active trade on Tuesday with 2.6 million shares or about 4.8 percent of its issued capital traded.
The bulk of the trade was in two lines, one of two million shares and one of 450,000 shares, both specialled through ANZ McCaughan at a price of A$3.16 per share.

GUD said it could shed no light on the trade, but suggested it may be portfolio repositioning following its recent scrip and cash takeover of appliance and mower manufacturer Sunbeam Victa Holdings Ltd.
GUD offered one GUD share and 54 cents cash for every three Sunbeam shares.
GUD said on September 26 it had about 96 percent of Sunbeam shares and was proceeding to compulsory acquisition.
Based on Sunbeam's issued capital of 60.88 million shares, the bid would have given rise to about 20.29 million new GUD shares.
By 1.45 p.m. (0345 GMT), GUD shares were steady at A$3.21 on turnover of 2.6 million shares.
